document_title: Tata Motors Standard Workshop Maintenance & Safety Operating Procedures
chapter: Chapter 1: Workshop Safety Protocols & High-Voltage De-energization
section: Section 1.1: EV 4-Step Zero-Voltage Safety Verification Protocol
content:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE: High-Voltage Vehicle De-energization and Touch-Safe Verification.
MANDATORY PPE: Class 0 electrical safety gloves (certified 1000V AC / 1500V DC working voltage, checked for pinholes via pneumatic inflation test), safety glasses with side shields, ESR composite toe safety boots.
STEP 1: SECURE WORK AREA: Place safety cordon posts and high-voltage warning signs around vehicle perimeter (2-meter radius).
STEP 2: IGNITION LOCKOUT: Switch ignition OFF, place vehicle key fob in RF-shielded Faraday pouch at least 5 meters away.
STEP 3: 12V ISOLATION: Disconnect auxiliary 12V battery negative ground terminal and insulate terminal lug.
STEP 4: MANUAL SERVICE DISCONNECT (MSD): Pull red locking tab on MSD plug, rotate lever 90 degrees, and pull plug outward. Lock MSD inside safety lockout box.
STEP 5: CAPACITOR DISCHARGE & VERIFICATION: Wait 10 minutes. Using CAT III / CAT IV 1000V rated DMM, measure between HV (+) and HV (-), HV (+) and chassis ground, and HV (-) and chassis ground at PDU test terminals.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: Residual voltage must measure strictly less than 10.0V DC before any mechanical disassembly.

document_title: Tata Motors Standard Workshop Maintenance & Safety Operating Procedures
chapter: Chapter 2: Periodic Maintenance Intervals & Lubrication Specifications
section: Section 2.3: Recommended Fluids, Capacities & Torque Table
content:
SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS & FASTENER TORQUE RATINGS:
1. Engine Oil Specification (2.0L Kryotec Diesel): SAE 0W-20 ACEA C5 / C2 Fully Synthetic Low-SAPS. Sump capacity: 5.0 Liters with filter. Oil drain plug torque: 28 Nm ± 2 Nm.
2. Engine Oil Specification (1.2L Revotron Turbo): SAE 5W-30 API SN Plus / ACEA A5/B5. Sump capacity: 3.5 Liters with filter. Oil drain plug torque: 25 Nm.
3. Wheel Lug Nuts (Harrier/Safari 5-Lug Alloy): 120 Nm ± 5 Nm (torque in star criss-cross pattern).
4. Spark Plugs (1.2L Petrol): 22 Nm ± 2 Nm (cold engine).
5. Brake Fluid: DOT 4 Low Viscosity (LV) ISO 4925 Class 6. Replacement interval: Every 24 months or 30,000 km.
6. EV Reduction Gearbox Transmission Fluid: Castrol BOT 351 EV / Shell E-Fluids. Sump capacity: 1.1 Liters. Fill/drain plug torque: 35 Nm.
